column1: # EXP-R2-225 Wave A, joint scale trajectory: stage-21 both-mode qualification of
# facebook/galactica-6.7b, the middle rung of 1.3 -> 6.7 -> 30B.
# One cell, and that is the whole campaign. The prereg's operational sequence
# verifies the smaller new arms first and only then attempts galactica-30b, so the
# 30B rung is a LATER dispatch against its own manifest rather than a second slot
# here: a slot barrier would release it minutes after this cell finishes, and at the
# measured ~2 MB/s staging link its 57 GB of weights are hours behind that.
# Every draw is named rather than implied, and each is the value the prereg binds
# this rung to for comparability with facebook/galactica-1.3b's existing
# qualification (results/transfer/external_baseline/20260822221334_7786dce63b35/
# s21_galactica-1.3b/joint_mode_qualification.json, whose settings block carries
# exactly these): corrected cohort draw seed 20260728, 128 scored records, a
# 400-record held-out unigram reference, residue band 64-246, text floor 800
# characters, a 512-token scored text window, and bfloat16. --modes both because
# D1.d's admission rule needs both and a checkpoint measured in one is not qualified.
# --protein-context is left at its default of none, so the protein block is the bare
# [START_AMINO]...[END_AMINO] rendering the 1.3B rung was qualified under.
# --checkpoint is a path and not an arm name on purpose: 21_joint_mode_qualification.py
# refuses to take an arm, because a checkpoint that has not passed this stage must not
# be in arms.py at all. ${TRANSFER_MODEL_BASE_DIR} is substituted by the runner from
# h200_env.sh, so no site path is written here.
# This qualification is not an admission, not a capability result, and not a licence
# to read a protein-side number: the protein mode enters ProteinGym or MegaScale only
# after it passes here.
